title: Put Off, Be Renewed, Put On
headline: What Replaces the Sin You Stop?
tagline: God isn’t merely interested in what you stop doing. He is forming what takes its place.
seo_title: Put Off, Put On: What Replaces the Sin You Stop? (Ephesians 4:22-24) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: The opposite of a sinful pattern isn't automatically Christlikeness. A devotional for men on Ephesians 4:22-24: put off, be renewed, put on.
verse_text: You were taught…. to put off your old self…. to be made new in the attitude of your minds; and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

scriptures.text: You were taught…. to put off your old self…. to be made new in the attitude of your minds; and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
….you have taken off your old self with its practices and have put on the new self….

items: Much of our approach to spiritual growth can be summarized with one word:
Sometimes stop is exactly what obedience requires.

sections.label: Empty Space Doesn’t Automatically Become Holy Space

items: A man realizes he needs to stop people-pleasing.
So he stops caring what people think.
Now he becomes cold, dismissive, unteachable.
He may have moved from one disorder to another.
Someone stops being controlling and becomes passive and irresponsible.
Someone stops arguing and emotionally withdraws.
Someone stops overworking and becomes lazy.

blocks.text: The opposite of a sinful pattern is not automatically Christlikeness.
“If I stop the bad behavior, the work is finished.”

items: Scripture asks a deeper question: what is taking its place?
Where there was fear, form trust.
Where there was comparison, form gratitude.
Where there was pride, form humility.
Where there was control, form dependence and faithful stewardship.
I don’t want merely an emptier life.
Don’t only ask what needs to leave. Ask what Christ intends to form in its place.
The destination isn’t merely improved behavior. The destination is increasing resemblance to Jesus.
